title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Red Hat Build of Apache Camel 4.18 for Quarkus 3.33 update is now available
description: A security update is available for Red Hat Build of Apache Camel 4.18 for Quarkus 3.33 addressing an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the Google Brotli Decoder component (CVE-2026-111497). This vulnerability is classified as a major incident and has a high severity rating. The update is provided as Red Hat build of Quarkus 3.33.4.SP2 to improve security and stability.
